meta.title: Resume Ingestion / Upload
meta.description: High-clarity entry point for resume upload and parsing. Drag-drop or file browse interface with clear feedback. Extracts structured data for profile and document generation.
meta.user_story: As a user, I can upload my resume and see clear parsing status with minimal friction.

user_flow.primary_path:
**Step 1: Land on ingestion screen** - User sees upload title and drag-drop zone - Instructions clearly indicate accepted formats (PDF, DOCX, TXT)
**Step 2: Upload resume** - Option A: Drag resume file onto drop zone - Option B: Click "Browse Files" button, select from file browser - File validation runs (type + size)
**Step 3: Parsing** - Status message updates: "Parsing: Extracting experience, skills, and contact info..." - Progress animation indicates active processing - Extraction happens in background
**Step 4: Review extracted data** - Once parsing complete, show extracted sections: - Experience - Skills - Education - Contact info - User can edit extracted data inline - Data automatically syncs to profile
**Step 5: Proceed** - User can confirm data and proceed to next feature - Or re-upload if extraction was poor - Data persists in Profile model
user_flow.edge_cases:
**Invalid file type:** - User uploads .jpg image - Show error: "Please upload a PDF, DOCX, or TXT file." - Drop zone remains active for retry
**File too large:** - User uploads 50MB file - Show error: "File size exceeds 25MB limit." - Suggest splitting resume or uploading text-only version
**Parse failure:** - Resume uploads but parsing fails (corrupted file, unusual format) - Show error: "Could not parse resume. Please check file format." - Offer suggestion to edit extracted data manually or re-upload
**No experience in resume:** - Resume has no work experience section - Show placeholder: "No experience found in resume. Add it manually?" - Allow user to add experience entries manually
**Slow upload:** - Network latency causes slow upload - Show persistent progress indicator - Allow cancel operation
**Re-upload:** - User wants to upload new resume - Show confirmation: "Replace current resume? Previous extracted data will be overwritten." - Allow retry with new file

states.default: - Drop zone visible and active - Browse button prominent - No status message - No extracted data
states.uploading: - Drop zone shows uploading state (opacity reduced) - Progress bar shows upload percentage - Status message: "Uploading: X% complete" - Browse button disabled
states.parsing: - Progress bar shows parsing percentage - Status message: "Parsing: Extracting experience, skills, and contact info..." - Spinner animation - Browse button disabled
states.complete: - Status message: "Resume parsed successfully!" - Success checkmark icon - Extracted data sections visible and editable - Drop zone becomes secondary (can upload another resume)
states.error: - MEGAPHONE error banner shows specific error - Drop zone shows error state (red border) - Error message appears below zone - Browse button re-enabled for retry

breakpoints.mobile: - Full-width layout with 16px padding - Drop zone height: 240px → 180px - Browse button: full-width - Extracted data: single-column stack - CSS: .ingestion-container { width: 100%; padding: 16px; }
breakpoints.tablet: - Max-width 700px, centered - Drop zone height: 240px - Browse button: 280px width, centered - Extracted data: single-column - Padding: 24px - CSS: @media (min-width: 768px) { .ingestion-container { max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto; } }
breakpoints.desktop: - Max-width 1280px, full-width - Drop zone height: 240px - Browse button: 280px width, centered - Extracted data: multi-column (Experience, Skills, Education side-by-side) - Padding: 48px - CSS: @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ingestion-container { max-width: 1280px; } }

accessibility_overview.focus_order:
1. Logo (skip-to-content) 2. Nav links 3. Browse Files button (primary file input trigger) 4. Extracted data sections (tabindex for editing) 5. Settings button
Keyboard shortcuts: - Enter: Open file dialog - Tab: Navigate sections - Esc: Cancel dialog
accessibility_overview.landmarks: role="main" → Upload container role="region" aria_label="Resume upload area" → Drop zone role="region" aria_live="polite" aria_label="Upload status" → Status role="region" aria_label="Extracted experience from resume" → Data sections
